correctness.rationale: For every k, the exact Eulerian formula reduces after n>=k to g0,g1. Both derivatives are t-1 mod3, yielding two isometric noncritical balls per parity; Hensel and a convergent 3-adic Morse coordinate give the even critical value zero and odd critical value A congruent 1 mod9, each with scaled square image. Exact root lifting gives all fibers. The modulo-three six-word and an isometric branch prove least period 2*3^k. A standalone exact-integer checker passed 29,634 assertions over all residues k=1..8; the proof, not finite cases, establishes infinite claims.

value.rationale: The exact infinite-depth 3-adic image and every fiber of the classical fixed two-descent Eulerian sequence form a motivated natural invariant. Two full 3-adic balls plus a disjoint critical translated-square sheet account for exceptional residues and growing fiber counts, yielding new exact rational Haar measure and sharp least periods. The full classification is not implied by classical enumerative formulas or valuation-only observations, and it is not an arbitrary parameter slice.
